name: remctl
description: Apple Reminders in Claude Code: RemCTL's tools, plus today's tasks above the prompt in your lists' colors.

display.title: Today: show tasks as
display.description: band: a summary and the next tasks above the prompt. compact: one line above the prompt. status: the status line. pane only: just /reminders.

rows.title: Today: tasks in the band
rows.description: How many tasks the band lists under its summary.

includeOverdue.title: Today: include overdue tasks
includeOverdue.description: Count and list reminders that were due before today.

lists.title: Today: only these lists
lists.description: Comma-separated Reminders list names. Leave empty for every list.

checkboxes.title: Today: complete from the pane
checkboxes.description: Show a check button beside each task in /reminders that marks it done in Reminders.

refreshMinutes.title: Today: refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often to read Reminders again. Changes Claude makes through RemCTL show right away.

openOnStart.title: Today: open the pane at start
openOnStart.description: Dock the /reminders pane beside the conversation when a session starts in a wide window.
